source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 04 Dipstick Service Hose Changes.pdf
title: Dipstick Service Hose Changes
lead: MOC has made improvements to the Dipstick Service Hoses used on the Dipstick Service Adapter (Part No. 94777). We have increased the length by 24" of both of these service hoses. Additionally, we replaced the hose connector on the Green Service hose (Part No. 94841).
body: To tell the old hose connector from the new one on the Green Service Hose (94841), look at the tip of the hose connector: the old connector has a blue plastic tip, the new connector has a metal tip.
